method: Assistant visual inspection of actual rendered CAD images; not an independent human reviewer or physical test.
checks: Rear motor long axis is vertical and output points toward short projecting jaws.
Front rectangular printed top/bottom guides correspond to reference topology; no metal guide rods.
Closed jaws remain parallel; linkage is behind the contact faces.
Exploded view shows separate retainers and integral printed pivot shoulders.
Optional camera remains a compact detachable add-on.
Print atlas is Z-up, with labels, dimensions, and localized jaw-support warning.
Overview and individual images are readable, unclipped, and consistently identified as R5.
